messages:
Alex Kim: Ugh construction next door wrecking my mic for standup :sob: anyone tried a balcony workaround?
Maria Chen: same here. moved to the balcony last week — surprisingly fine but wind is annoying. pro tip: slip the mic under your shirt collar or use a noise gate.
Devon R: or hotspot + wired earbuds. tethering to my phone saved me during a demo once. battery drain was rough tho.
Alex Kim: Tried tethering for the morning standup — ~80ms to our region, totally usable. posting my balcony rig pic: <https://img.redwood.internal/alex-balcony-rig.jpg> (phone on tripod, plant for ambience)
Jules Park: love the fern 🌿 looks v professional. aesthetic wins.
Maria Chen: also, powerline adapters saved my brain when my router started dying. plug in, wait 30s, done.
Devon R: which model did you get? I'm allergic to fiddly setups.
Maria Chen: TP-Link AV1000. plug 'n' play. not great on very old wiring but 9/10 better than 3 bar wifi.
Alex Kim: quick command I used to make a hotspot on linux when tethering: `sudo nmcli device wifi hotspot ifname wlp3s0 ssid 'alex-hotspot' password 'replace-with-strong-pass'` — works in a pinch.
WifiBot: Reminder: if you're hotspotting for work, keep VPN on and avoid exposing prod services :lock: (auto-check 1/1).
Alex Kim: Good call, thanks! Also low-key offering to trade my extra ethernet adapter for custody of the fern if anyone's local :grin:
Jules Park: :thumbsup: Deal. porch pickup at 5pm? (reaction :thumbsup: by Maria Chen)
Maria Chen: I'll bring a spare ethernet cable just in case :party-parrot:
Devon R: saving this thread for future emergency WFH hacks.
Alex Kim: cheers everyone — mic survived standup, win!
